META.TITLE: Okan Kaplan | Web Developer – Angular & FastAPI
META.DESCRIPTION: Okan Kaplan – a web developer based near Stuttgart, Germany. Explore SmartDesk and other projects built with Angular, TypeScript, Python and FastAPI.
META.OG_DESCRIPTION: Web applications built with Angular and FastAPI. Projects, technologies and contact information.

ABOUT.INTRO: I'm Okan, a web developer based near Stuttgart, Germany. I use Angular and TypeScript to build clear, responsive interfaces. In SmartDesk, I connect the frontend to my own Python and FastAPI backend and a PostgreSQL database. I enjoy building applications that make real workflows easier to understand and use.

PORTFOLIO.TITLE: My Projects
PORTFOLIO.INTRO: From a JavaScript game to a full-stack application: these projects show how I bring interfaces, features and data together.

JOIN.TITLE: Join
JOIN.DESCRIPTION: A Kanban-style task manager built as a team project. Organize tasks with drag and drop, assign them to team members and sort them into categories.

POLLO_LOCO.TITLE: Pollo Loco
POLLO_LOCO.DESCRIPTION: A browser game built with object-oriented JavaScript. Help Pepe run, jump, throw salsa bottles, collect coins and take on the crazy chicken.

POKEDEX.TITLE: Pokédex
POKEDEX.DESCRIPTION: Based on the PokéAPI a simple library that provides and catalogues pokemon information.

SMARTDESK.TITLE: SmartDesk
SMARTDESK.DESCRIPTION: An IT help desk application with three roles, a defined ticket lifecycle and a full change history. Built with Angular, FastAPI and PostgreSQL, covered by more than 250 automated tests, and running live with a private demo workspace for every visitor.
SMARTDESK.IMAGE_ALT: SmartDesk dashboard from the support team's perspective with metrics, status filters and a ticket list
SMARTDESK.WORKFLOW: Create, assign, resolve and close tickets
SMARTDESK.ROLES: Separate permissions for employees, support agents and administrators
SMARTDESK.HISTORY: Comments and a traceable change history
SMARTDESK.DEMO_NOTE: No account needed: in the live demo, click “Demo starten” (Start demo) and switch roles via “Ansicht als” (View as). The demo is in German, and your private workspace is deleted automatically after 24 hours.
